payload.title: A section lists the personas that report for it
payload.description:
Each section has an ordered list of personas allowed to report for it, edited beside the section's mission and policy. A persona can serve several sections.
Scenario: an editor links two personas to a section and the assignment form offers only those two. Scenario: a section with no personas while the feature is on refuses to assign a Story and says why, rather than picking one silently.
